The alternative ...bxc6 also recaptures, but creates doubled c-pawns. After ...Qxc6, White can challenge the center with d4; one legal continuation is d4 exd4 Nxd4 Bxd4 Bxd4, exchanging another pair of minor pieces. Black retains the bishop pair immediately after the queen recapture, although that continuation trades one bishop for White?s knight. As a workshop analogy, the original brass valve is taken out of service and replaced by a different complete valve.
